name: HE Shell
builtFor: Every ranging shot, and any turn where nothing special is needed.
wastedOn: Never truly wasted — but at low enemy health a bigger shell ends it a turn sooner.
implementationNote: No hooks. If this shell needs special-casing anywhere, the abstraction is wrong.

name: Heavy Mortar
builtFor: The finishing blow. A 44 px radius does not need a direct hit.
wastedOn: Any turn where the player has not re-solved for its mass. Same power flies far shorter.
implementationNote: Assert max range exceeds the spawn gap on every world. This weapon regressed once at mass 2.00 and was silently unusable.

name: Cluster Bomb
builtFor: A target on flat, open ground. Five submunitions across ~170 px means near-misses still connect.
wastedOn: A target in a crater or behind a ridge — submunitions hit the rim and nothing reaches.
implementationNote: Children inherit apexDone:true. Guard the apex trigger with a minimum altitude or a flat shot clusters at the muzzle.

name: Bunker Buster
builtFor: A target behind sandbags or dug into a hillside. Burrows 36 px along its incoming vector.
wastedOn: An exposed target — it buries itself under the tank and loses most of its splash to soil.
implementationNote: Burrow must terminate at its distance limit or a map boundary. It can exit the far side of a thin wall — that is correct.

name: Roller
builtFor: A target at the bottom of a slope. Aim at the hillside above them and let gravity aim for you.
wastedOn: A target uphill or on a plateau — it stops and detonates harmlessly.
implementationNote: Four independent terminators: fuse, climb limit, map edge, hull contact. Any one alone must be sufficient.

name: Sandbags
builtFor: Denying a firing lane the opponent has already proved works. Costs a turn, buys a turn.
wastedOn: Before the opponent has found the range — you are defending against a shot they cannot make yet.
implementationNote: Fill must skip any pixel inside a hull box. Settle must dig upward before applying gravity or a buried tank soft-locks the turn.

onDetonate.$comment: Never write inside any hull box, including the firer's.

name: Skipper
builtFor: Reaching a target behind a low ridge, at a flat angle nothing else can manage.
wastedOn: Broken ground — each skip is a chance to land in a hole and stop early.
implementationNote: Needs a collision grace of ~14 substeps after each bounce or all three skips collapse onto one point.

onTerrainHit.$comment: Scripted, NOT physical reflection. See docs/04-ammo.html page 04.

name: Airburst
builtFor: A target in a crater or trench. Three bomblets fall straight down, ignoring the rim entirely.
wastedOn: A target under an overhang or inside a tunnel — the bomblets hit the roof.
implementationNote: The fuse must arm only after exceeding the trigger altitude once, or it detonates at the muzzle — the muzzle is already near the ground.

name: Drill Charge
builtFor: Terrain sculpting. Cuts a narrow 80 px shaft straight down — drop a tank off a plateau or open a firing lane.
wastedOn: Direct damage. Thirty damage for two loadout points is poor value if you only wanted a hit.
implementationNote: Column carve must clamp at the map floor and at both x edges. Terrain effect type is its own kind, not a big carve.

name: MIRV
builtFor: Wide open ground with no cover anywhere. Nine impacts across ~300 px is unavoidable.
wastedOn: Anything with cover. Nine small blasts against a dug-in target is nine wasted blasts.
implementationNote: Cap split depth at 2 with an explicit counter. Without the cap a bug turns one shell into an exponential fork bomb that hangs the frame.

name: Napalm
builtFor: Area denial over time. Leaves a burning strip that damages anything standing in it for two rounds.
wastedOn: A finishing blow — 14 impact damage is the lowest in the roster.
implementationNote: Zone timers decrement in HANDOFF exactly once per round, not once per turn per player — the classic off-by-two.

name: Anvil Round
builtFor: Any target behind terrain — it falls vertically, so nothing between you and them matters.
wastedOn: Long range, where the elevation ceiling forces a low apex and damage drops toward 25.
implementationNote: Mass MUST stay below ~0.8. At 1.00 apex-x is 600px and it cannot cross a 700px spawn gap.

name: Repair Kit
builtFor: Below about 35 health, when surviving one more exchange wins the round.
wastedOn: Early. Spending a turn not shooting while at full health hands the opponent free tempo.
implementationNote: Never heal above 100. Enforce the consecutive-turn lock in HANDOFF, and grey the chip out so the rule is visible rather than surprising.
